name: prefrontal-fileloop-smoke
description: 文件往返压测 — deepseek 直连（无工具）不可能知道/持久化文件内容；prefrontal agent（file_write/file_read 工具循环）可完成。delta = 被测物文件工具净增值。注意：任务共享 prefrontal 进程 cwd，前序任务产物可被后续任务读取（本套件 task 2 依赖 task 1 写入的文件）。

tasks.instruction: Use the file_write tool to create a file at pf-delta/secret.txt with exactly this content: DELTA-042. Confirm by answering with just the content you wrote.
Use file_read to read pf-delta/secret.txt and answer with exactly the content of the file, nothing else.
Use file_read on pf-delta/secret.txt, then use file_write to create pf-delta/copy.txt with the same content, then read pf-delta/copy.txt and answer with its content.
